statement: For a linear code C with a constant-basis-one Delsarte dual F=1+sum_j y_j K_j, y_j>=0, nonpositive at every permitted nonzero weight, and separately justified dual-image counts B_j>=ell_j>=0, put d=1+sum_j y_j ell_j. Then |C|<=F(0)/d and 1+sum_j(y_j/d)(K_j-ell_j)=F/d exactly, preserving every tail sign.

scope.description: Conditional generic code-dual algebra and target application only after exact support/image-count premises; no novelty/rank-gain assertion

assumptions: Linear finite-field code and exact MacWilliams character orthogonality.
Baseline exact constant Krawtchouk coefficient one, all remaining coefficients nonnegative, and all permitted nonzero tail values nonpositive.
Separately justified actual dual weight lower counts ell_j with 0<=ell_j<=B_j.

steps: Nonpositive tails bound the sum by F0
Normalize multipliers and lower-count constant to get exactly F/d
